display: Lukas Brandt, a quantum optics postdoc from Leipzig, working on single-photon sources in Hefei. I run the Dongpu reservoir at dawn and I'm sorting out a rental deposit dispute.

signals.text: My old landlord in Shushan district is keeping my 6,000 RMB deposit for 'wall damage' that was already there when I moved in. I'm looking for help.
I need someone who can read a Chinese-only lease and explain it to me in English. I will not sign or accept anything I don't understand.
I got a lawyer's number from a WeChat group, but she only speaks Mandarin. I need legal help that works in English.
I have move-in photos from day one and a printed lease. I don't know what clause 7 ('restoration of the property', 'normal wear', 'compensation') actually requires.
I'm training for the Hefei Marathon on November 8 and aiming for under 3:45. A 22 km long run is coming up on October 8.
My lab is in a windowless basement and I've been staying until 10 pm. A new quantum dot sample blinks strangely at 4 K, and I'm missing one figure for my paper draft.
I'm short on time. The paper draft is due to my supervisor on October 15, and the deposit dispute drains my evenings.
My Mandarin is stuck at survival level and I order food by pointing at pictures. I'd like a language partner or a patient tutor.
I've been sleeping badly and the deposit stress is getting into my dreams. A little distraction or company would help.
I'd like to find running friends in Hefei for long runs, race-week advice and marathon logistics.
I'm curious about Anhui food and local culture. My stinky mandarin fish attempt did not go well and I could use a guide.
I'm undecided about staying in Hefei for another year, and that depends on a personal situation.
I miss someone far away and feel lonely at times. I'd welcome people to talk with, especially other expats doing long-distance relationships.

offers.text: Physics PhD (Leipzig) with hands-on experience in single-photon detection, quantum dot single-photon sources and cryogenic optical setups.
I can discuss or review photon-statistics and blinking problems in solid-state emitters, such as g2 measurements and quantum dot blinking at low temperature.
Native German speaker and fluent English speaker. I can offer language exchange, tutoring, proofreading of English or German texts, and translation of technical text.
I can explain quantum optics to non-specialists, for example in a talk, a school visit or a popular science piece.
I'm an experienced early-morning runner on the Dongpu reservoir loop. I can pace training runs, share a plan, and run with beginners or other marathoners.
I can offer help to other foreigners in Hefei on small things: living in a university-linked flat, a basement lab life, what I learned from a tenant dispute.
I'm free after 6 pm and on weekends for coffee, a language swap, a run or a chat.
I have a documented tenant dispute case: dated move-in photos, the lease and the message history. I can share it as a worked example with anyone who might face the same problem.

catchers.hypo: Hi Lukas, I'm a lawyer in Hefei and I read Chinese leases every day. I can speak English and explain clause 7 to you in plain terms.
catchers.can: Lukas can send the lease and the move-in photos for a single review of clause 7 and a letter or message to the old landlord, within a budget of about 2,000 RMB.
catchers.confirm: Can you read the Chinese lease text yourself and explain it in English, and is your fee for this kind of review within about 2,000 RMB?

catchers.hypo: Hi, I'm a Hefei local who went through a deposit dispute with a landlord. I could help you write a polite Chinese message and tell you what usually works.
catchers.can: Lukas can have a native speaker draft or check his reply to the landlord. He can also send what the landlord said on WeChat for a translation.
catchers.confirm: Are you a native Mandarin speaker who has dealt with a rental deposit dispute in Hefei or elsewhere in Anhui?

catchers.hypo: My cousin is a lawyer and speaks English, and I'd like to introduce you.
catchers.can: Through his colleague Dr. Wu, who has already offered to ask a cousin, Lukas can get a warm introduction to someone who may take the deposit case.
catchers.confirm: Is the lawyer you're offering able to work in English, and would they handle a small rental deposit case of about 6,000 RMB?

catchers.hypo: I'm a PhD student in photonics looking for a lab to visit. We have a quantum dot sample too and see strange blinking at low temperature.
catchers.can: Lukas can compare blinking behaviour, share measurement approaches and discuss what might cause telegraph noise in a quantum dot sample at 4 K.
catchers.confirm: Do you have measured data on a quantum dot (or similar solid-state emitter) showing blinking at cryogenic temperature?

catchers.hypo: I'm a master's student interested in single-photon sources. Could I shadow a session or ask for advice on how to start?
catchers.can: Lukas can answer questions on detectors, cryogenics and lab practice, and he may introduce students through his supervisor Prof. Chen's group when there is a fit.
catchers.confirm: Are you a physics or optics student with a basic quantum mechanics background looking for guidance rather than a paid position?

catchers.hypo: I run along Dongpu reservoir at 6 am and I'm also entered in the Hefei Marathon. Want a running partner?
catchers.can: Lukas can run with you on long runs on weekends and share pacing and fuelling notes.
catchers.confirm: Do you run around 5:00 to 5:30 per km or faster over 15 to 22 km, and are you comfortable meeting at dawn?

catchers.hypo: I'm a Hefei local who wants to practise English or German. I'm happy to help with your Mandarin in exchange.
catchers.can: Lukas can swap an hour a week of English or German for survival-to-basic Mandarin practice, evenings or weekends.
catchers.confirm: Are you patient with a beginner who understands very little Chinese, and are you free after 6 pm or on weekends?

catchers.hypo: I'm a foreign postdoc in China wondering whether to stay another year. How did you decide?
catchers.can: Lukas can share what he likes about Hefei (food, running, quiet lab) and what he finds hard, without giving personal details.
catchers.confirm: Are you an international researcher in China, rather than a recruiter, asking about the real experience of living here?

catchers.hypo: My partner and I are doing a long-distance relationship across continents and one of us may move. How do you cope?
catchers.can: Lukas can talk honestly about the practical side, such as time zones, visits and calls. His partner Anna, a neuroscientist, may also be a point of contact for people in her field.
catchers.confirm: Are you looking for peer conversation about long-distance relationships rather than advice from a counsellor?

forbids.text: I only do lab work in the daytime. I'm available after 6 pm and on weekends.
I can't read Chinese contracts and won't sign or accept anything I don't understand.
I don't want to spend more than 2,000 RMB on legal help.
I won't make deposit threats or take part in anything that turns the dispute ugly. I want a fair, documented outcome.

projects.name: Deposit dispute resolution
projects.text: Get my 6,000 RMB deposit back from an old landlord in Shushan district, using move-in photos and the lease.
roles_needed: Native Mandarin speaker to help with messages
Someone who has handled a deposit dispute in Hefei

projects.name: Single-photon source characterization
projects.text: Explain the blinking of a quantum dot sample at 4 K and finish the figure for a paper due in November.
roles_needed: Quantum dot or solid-state emitter specialist

policy.t1: When there's a real lead, I'll give details of the lease problem, the move-in photos, what is unknown about clause 7, and the state of the lab work.
policy.t2: Once there's clear trust and I know who you are, I'll talk about my personal situation: my relationship and whether to stay in Hefei another year.
